snippet.title: Devil's Dice - Early Access Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Devil's Dice is a game about rolling the dice to pay off your debt. Fail, and you'll have to pay the consequences.

Buy trinkets to tilt the odds in your favour and try not to fall behind on your payments.

The game is currently in Early Access and is playable from start to finish, including an endless mode.

https://journeymanstudiosofficial.itch.io/devils-dice
